dedupe_keys.name: environmental flow requirements from ferc hydropower licences across the us ornl hydrosource

description: This dataset lists the environmental flow requirements written into the Protection, Mitigation and Enhancement section of 50 randomly selected Federal Energy Regulatory Commission hydropower licences: 25 issued in 1998-2013 that are also in the ORNL Mitigation Database and 25 issued since 2014. Each requirement is categorised by purpose (fisheries or habitat, recreation, industry, general) and by flow type (minimum, maximum, ramping rate and others), with its period, whether it is continuous or instantaneous, any wet, dry or normal water-year condition, the zone it applies to, and the facility's maximum discharge capacity taken from the Existing Hydropower Assets dataset and the National Inventory of Dams. Oak Ridge National Laboratory produced it for the DOE Water Power Technologies Office and publishes it on HydroSource as a single XLSX download with an OSTI DOI; HydroSource data are openly shared without restriction and free, with citation requested. Caveats: coverage is a sample of 50 licences, not the full national fleet of about 1,000 projects, and requirements are transcribed from licence text, not measured releases. Simulation uses: operating constraints for reservoir and hydropower scheduling optimisation and for testing the flexibility available to a grid under climate adaptation. Related record: the US National Inventory of Dams (data-usace-national-inventory-of-dams).
licence: Openly shared without restriction under the DOE Public Access Plan (HydroSource data use policy); citation requested
name: Environmental flow requirements from FERC hydropower licences across the US (ORNL HydroSource)
notes: The OSTI page lists a larger successor, 'Comprehensive Database of Environmental Mitigations Extracted from FERC-Licensed Hydropower Projects Using Artificial Intelligence Techniques, 1998-2023' (OSTI 2570983, 461 licences, 17,612 mitigations in 128 categories); not yet catalogued. HydroSource itself hosts further hydropower datasets (Existing Hydropower Assets and others) that belong to the energy piece.
provider: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (HydroSource, DOE Water Power Technologies Office)
schema_summary: per flow requirement: FERC project, EHA project code, augmentation category (fisheries or habitat, recreation, industry, general), flow type (minimum, maximum, ramping rate and others), period, continuous or instantaneous, wet/dry/normal year condition, zone, and maximum discharge capacity from EHA and NID

sources.note: authors, 50 licences, categories, XLSX 105.8 kB, publication date July 26 2022

spatial_resolution: individual hydropower projects, with zone (dam, powerhouse, bypass reach)
temporal_resolution: per requirement, with seasonal or water-year periods where the licence states them
